description: Lore documentation factory — deterministic enforcement of BLOCKING DoD rules + upkeep. Paths are resolved relative to the project root (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR / payload cwd); JSON is parsed via jq → python3 → sed, warning loudly if none are available. check-image-path.sh blocks (exit 2) any docs/ markdown or MDX referencing /static/img/, or any image written under docs/ (§6/Rule 1). check-frontmatter.sh blocks (exit 2) any docs/ markdown/MDX missing valid frontmatter keys (§2/§6). check-no-tooling-refs.sh blocks (exit 2) any docs/ markdown/MDX referencing the authoring tooling — .claude/ paths, CLAUDE.md citations, or lore:* skill/subagent names (Rule 5/§6). verify-docs.sh (Stop) blocks (exit 2) images under docs/ and /static/img/ refs, and warns about orphan images; it honors stop_hook_active to avoid loops. sync-lore-files.sh (SessionStart) keeps plugin-owned files (lore-methodology.md) in sync with the installed plugin version — silent copy + a one-line notice on update; only touches a project whose CLAUDE.md imports the methodology file. Scope carve-out: .claude/**, templates/**, and _templates/** intentional examples are ignored.
